title: Spectral reweighting has an exact Maxwell and radial energy-exchange defect

weighted_exchange.weight: Let w(Q)>=0 be a Borel spectral weight on a smooth common core and let c>=0 be the coefficient assigned to the single Maxwell energy and original quartic potential.
weighted_exchange.weighted_current: j_w^a=e Im<w(Q)Qphi,D^a phi>; the physical Maxwell equation is sourced only by j_1^a=e Im<Qphi,D^a phi>.
weighted_exchange.exact_identity: dH_(w,c)/dt=integral E dot (j_w-c j_1) dx + lambda integral ||phi||^2 Re<(w(Q)-c I)phi,pi> dx, up to the fixed repository sign convention shared by all three displayed terms.
weighted_exchange.constant_control: For w=c I both defects vanish and H_(cI,c)=c E_mu is exactly the original conserved energy.
weighted_exchange.polynomial_lifts: For w(q)=q^(2n), n>=1, the first defect is the uncancelled lifted current and the second is the radial spectral-weight defect; neither is canceled by the one Maxwell equation.
weighted_exchange.spectral_support: K1403 permits testing the identity on arbitrary finite collections of charge eigenspaces without generating other charges.
weighted_exchange.boundary: The identity classifies time-independent quadratic spectral reweightings of the existing energy. It does not cover nonlinear normal forms, spacetime estimates, time-dependent corrections or an infinite coupled hierarchy.
